dedupe_keys.name: reservas naturales fluviales de la demarcacion hidrografica del guadalquivir

description: Reservas Naturales Fluviales de la demarcación hidrográfica del Guadalquivir is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Identificación y delimitación de las Reservas Fluviales de la Demarcación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Las reservas naturales fluviales tienen la finalidad de preservar, sin alteraciones, aquellos tramos de ríos con escasa o nula intervención humana. Estas reservas se circunscribirán estrictamente a los bienes de dominio público hidráulico. Coverage: Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. The publisher named on the listing is Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Its keywords include RNF, zonas protegidas, lugares protegidos. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, X-ZIPPED-SHP, WMS, GEO%2BJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://idechg.chguadalquivir.es/geochg/legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
